radar_crypto.label: Crypto

forecast.label: Forecast
forecast.description: Enter your numbers to see a hypothetical projection of your capital.

yield.title: Yield
yield.full: How much the capital grows in one year with this instrument, in % per year.

growth.title: Growth potential
growth.short: Chance of the asset price rising
growth.full: Long-term potential of the asset to gain value, regardless of payouts.

passive.title: Simplicity
passive.short: How hard it is to manage
passive.full: Knowledge and effort required. A high score means the asset needs little expertise or involvement.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.short: How fast it turns into cash
liquidity.full: How quickly you can withdraw funds without losing value. For Tyrex: stopping mining starts a cooling period before funds return.

entry.title: Entry threshold
entry.short: How much money you need to start
entry.full: Financial accessibility. The higher the score on the chart, the SMALLER the amount needed to start.

safety.title: Safety
safety.full: Overall reliability estimate. A higher score means a lower chance of drawdown. Any investment carries risk.

radar.scoreNote: Scores are the platform's own estimates, not independent ratings.

Real Estate.label: Real estate
Real Estate.conclusion: Real estate holds value well but needs a large starting capital and is slow to sell. Tyrex starts from the price of one node; its yield is a fixed tariff rate set by the platform.

Bank Deposit.label: Bank
Bank Deposit.conclusion: Bank deposits are regulated and protected, but the rate is often close to inflation. Tyrex offers a higher fixed tariff rate, without deposit insurance.

S&P 500.label: Stocks
S&P 500.conclusion: Stocks have grown over the long run but are volatile and require market knowledge. Tyrex accrues a fixed tariff rate without active management.

Gold.label: Gold
Gold.conclusion: Gold preserves value but generates no passive income. Tyrex accrues income daily at the tariff rate, but it is a different risk profile.

Business.label: Business
Business.conclusion: Your own business can bring high income but takes full involvement and carries high risk. Tyrex requires no involvement after purchase and start.

Funds.label: Funds
Funds.conclusion: Funds are easy to hold but charge fees and give no control over assets. In Tyrex you see accruals for each node directly.

Staking.label: Staking
Staking.conclusion: Staking pays a modest rate and often locks coins for a period. Tyrex also has a lock: after stopping a node there is a cooling period before funds return.

Mining.label: Mining
Mining.conclusion: Mining requires buying hardware and paying for electricity. Tyrex nodes need no equipment; income is a fixed tariff rate.

Trading.label: Trading
Trading.conclusion: Trading can bring high profit but also full loss of the deposit and needs constant attention. Tyrex is passive and accrues at a fixed rate.

Altcoins.label: Altcoins
Altcoins.conclusion: Altcoins can rise many times or fall to zero. Tyrex nodes are tied to BTC and accrue a fixed tariff rate.

Bots.label: Bots
Bots.conclusion: Trading bots automate trades but can lose money in unstable markets. Tyrex accrues income at the tariff rate without trading settings.

Signals.label: Signals
Signals.conclusion: Signals depend on someone else's analysis and manual execution. Tyrex requires no trading decisions after start.

yield.label: Node yield
yield.description: Base yield of your nodes. With active nodes it's your average APY; otherwise the lowest tariff rate.

boosters.label: Boosters
boosters.description: Hypothetical extra yield. Not a current platform feature — use it to model scenarios.

spec.label: Trading
spec.description: Hypothetical income from your own trading strategies. Not provided by the platform.

btc.label: BTC growth
btc.description: Your assumption about BTC price growth per year. Off by default — BTC can also fall.

ref.label: Referrals
ref.description: Approximate income from the partner program. Depends on your partners' activity.

forecast.reached: Target reached: {{date}} ({{count}} mo.) — in this hypothetical scenario.
forecast.notReached: With these parameters the target is beyond the planning horizon.
forecast.disclaimer: Hypothetical calculation for illustration only. Not a forecast or a guarantee of income; actual results may differ, including losses.
